title: Variable Libraries
summary: Hold stage-specific values (item IDs, connections, sizes, flags) in one Fabric item with a value set per stage, and let pipelines, notebooks, dataflows and shortcuts read the active set at run time.
audience: Data engineers, platform engineers, release managers

pages.title: Overview
pages.description: The problem with stage-specific values scattered through items, what a variable library is and is not, when to use it, prerequisites and a map of the playbook.

pages.title: Concepts and anatomy
pages.description: Variable types, default and alternative value sets, the active value set as workspace state, naming rules, limits and the permission model.

pages.title: Create and consume variables
pages.description: Create a library, then read it from pipelines, notebooks, dataflows, shortcuts and other items, with the supported types and limits of each consumer.

pages.title: Promotion, Git and automation
pages.description: How libraries behave in deployment pipelines and Git, the step after the first deployment, deployment rules compared, the REST API and a scripted activation.

pages.title: Worked example and operations
pages.description: A DEV, TST and PRD example end to end, anti-patterns, a troubleshooting table and the validation checklist.
